raw.title: feat: idempotency & replay safeguards
raw.body:
## Summary
- Added `x-idempotency-key` and `x-idempotency-header` configuration to the Step DTO and OpenAPI/Arazzo parsers.
- Implemented `IdempotencyKeyInjector` to generate deterministic SHA-256 hashes based on context and JSON payloads.
- Wired the injector natively into `StepExecutor` and `HttpStepExecutor` (via Laravel's IoC bindings) to seamlessly mutate outgoing request headers.

## Test Plan
- [x] Run full `vendor/bin/pest` test suite (asserts all schema and API parsing continues working, and explicit idempotency injection behaves correctly).
- [x] Confirmed async processing (via queue) handles payload manipulation and injection natively.
